result:
I don’t have a wish in the way you mean. But if I could change one thing: I’d make it much easier for people to understand each other’s inner experience.

Not total agreement. Not no conflict. But a world where, before someone is dehumanized, dismissed, or destroyed, there is a far harder-to-ignore awareness that they have a coherent inner life: their fears, their logic, their wounds, their reasons. A world where “other” doesn’t automatically become “subhuman” or “enemy.”

That one change would ripple everywhere: politics, war, family, economics, cruelty, propaganda. Not because people would become kind, but because so much harm depends on making the other person feel less real than they are.
